caption:
Thousands of independent vet practices, and no community to lean on. 🧡

Amy of VetCircle shares why they started: owners were figuring it out alone, and many sold their practices because they were burnt out.

So they built a safe space where owners can share and get support. That's how VetCircle began.

Follow for more community ideas.
